Le règlement des études 2025-2026 des masters de l'Institut Polytechnique de Paris interdit l'utilisation de l'intelligence artificielle générative dans les évaluations de ces programmes, sauf autorisation explicite de l'enseignant dans ses consignes écrites. Under Institut Polytechnique de Paris's 2025-2026 Master programs academic regulations, when generative AI use is explicitly permitted by an instructor, students must clearly acknowledge its use in accordance with standard citation practices.

disclosure.en: The 2026–27 Master rules require systematic, precise and detailed disclosure for permitted non-exam AI support; examination citation follows academic citation rules. Citation alone does not authorize use.
disclosure.zh: 2026–2027 学年硕士规章要求，在平时课业中使用 AI 辅助必须进行系统、准确且详尽的披露；考试中若获准使用 AI 则必须严格遵守学术引用规则。仅进行引用绝不构成对未授权使用行为的合法化许可。

privacy_data.en: The Master regulation requires confidentiality for scientific, technical and institutional information. It does not establish AI vendor training, retention or student account controls.
privacy_data.zh: 硕士研究生规章要求学生在科研与论文撰写过程中对科学、技术及机构信息严格负有无期限保密义务。现有证据未确立 AI 服务商模型训练、数据留存或学生账号安全控制规则。

approved_tools.en: No student product access, procurement, cost or endorsement is established by this review. Teacher-facing resources are not student access or assessment permission.
approved_tools.zh: 在当前审核证据中，尚未确立面向全校学生的签约 AI 产品访问权限、采购安排、费用支持或官方推荐。面向教师的教学资源不代表学生具有工具权限或考核许可。

research_publication.en: The regulation states confidentiality duties for Master research and thesis information; broader thesis, publication and third-party service conditions remain unverified.
research_publication.zh: 学习规章明确规定了硕士研究生在科研与论文信息方面的无期限保密义务；更广泛的学位论文出版、公开发表及第三方 AI 服务使用条件在现有证据中仍未核实。

academic_integrity.en: For 2026–27 IP Paris M1/M2, unauthorized exam AI use is fraud and reproduction beyond duly cited short excerpts is plagiarism. Academic penalties and disciplinary jurisdiction are stated separately; no numerical appeal deadline is established.
academic_integrity.zh: 对 2026–2027 学年 IP Paris 硕士 M1/M2 学生，未经授权在考试中使用 AI 构成学术舞弊，直接复制超出规范引注短摘录的 AI 生成内容构成抄袭剽窃。舞弊将导致成绩记 0 分、课程不予通过并移交学术委员会纪律分会处分；若涉嫌违纪发生于成员学校等其他公立高等教育机构，由该机构纪律委员会管辖并通报 IP Paris 主席。规章中未设立数字化的具体申诉期限。

teaching_guidance.en: École polytechnique’s instructor resource catalogue lists Turnitin, AI Text Classifier and GPTZero, including a Moodle authenticity workflow. This is teacher-facing resource guidance, not a detector accuracy finding or student permission.
teaching_guidance.zh: 巴黎综合理工学院（École polytechnique）面向教师的教学资源目录列出了 Turnitin、AI Text Classifier 和 GPTZero 等工具，包括与 Moodle 关联的原创性检查工作流。此属面向教师的教学资源指南，不构成对检测器准确度的官方认定，亦不赋予学生考核使用许可。

security_procurement.en: Central institutional IT security evaluations, commercial vendor data agreements, and unified procurement catalogs for artificial intelligence platforms remain an unverified evidence gap.
security_procurement.zh: 针对人工智能平台的校级中央 IT 安全评估规程、商业供应商数据保护协议及统一采购目录在当前公开证据中仍属未核实的证据缺口。

do.en: Systematically, precisely, and fully disclose any use of generative AI in coursework (information searching, knowledge deepening, or method testing), and follow academic citation rules when authorized in exams.
do.zh: 在课程作业中使用生成式 AI 辅助检索信息、深化知识或测试方法时，必须系统、准确且详细地说明 AI 的使用情况；在考试获准使用时必须严格遵循学术引用规则进行标注。

do.en: Keep all scientific, technical, and institutional data from IP Paris or affiliated research laboratories strictly confidential without time limitation when conducting research or preparing theses.
do.zh: 在开展研究与撰写学位论文过程中，对所接触到的属于 IP Paris 或其所属研究中心的科学、技术及机构信息，必须无期限严格保守机密。

do.en: Check course-specific instructions and partner school arrangements in advance; note that formal exceptions for external partner or dual-degree Master elements must be submitted by the program lead (responsable de la formation) to the Graduate School direction for prior approval before September 1.
do.zh: 在修读前核实各课程的具体教学说明与合作学校安排；请注意，涉及外部合作高校或双学位硕士培养环节的正式例外规则，须由培养项目负责人（responsable de la formation）于学年开始前（9 月 1 日前）报送研究生院管理部门事先批准，而非由学生自行申请。

dont.en: For IP Paris 2026–27 Master M1/M2 students, do not use generative AI in any examination unless the instructor has given explicit authorization in their instructions; do not use AI in coursework where the instructor has explicitly prohibited it in instructions. Unauthorized use is treated as fraud resulting in a non-compensable grade of 0 for the course unit, potential denial of a resit/annual postponement, and possible disciplinary sanctions.
dont.zh: 对于 2026–27 学年 IP Paris 硕士 M1/M2 学生，严禁在任何形式的考试中使用生成式 AI，除非授课教师在其考核说明中给予明确许可；亦严禁在教师已于考核要求中明确禁止的平时作业中使用 AI。未经授权的使用按舞弊处理，将导致该教学单元被记为不可弥补的 0 分，并可能由考评团决定取消第二考期资格导致学年延期，且不影响可能实施的纪律处分。

dont.en: Do not reproduce AI-generated text, code, or outputs without explicit indication or beyond properly cited short excerpts; presenting AI outputs as personal creation constitutes plagiarism.
dont.zh: 严禁在未予明确说明的情况下直接复制 AI 生成的文本、代码或计算结果，亦不得超出规范引注的短篇摘录范围；将 AI 生成内容冒充个人成果提交直接构成抄袭剽窃。

dont.en: Avoid inputting confidential laboratory or institutional research data into third-party AI tools (site advice deduced from general research confidentiality obligations, not an explicit AI-specific platform contract); note that where alleged misconduct occurs at a member school or other public higher-education institution, disciplinary jurisdiction belongs to that institution.
dont.zh: 切勿将实验室机密或机构科研数据录入第三方 AI 工具（此为根据通用科研保密义务推断的网站建议，本次审核材料尚未核实针对 AI 平台的采购/数据处理协议）；同时须知若涉嫌违纪行为发生在成员学校等外部公立高教机构，纪律管辖权归属该机构并通报 IP Paris 主席。

topicBasis.teaching_guidance: École polytechnique’s instructor resource catalogue lists Turnitin, AI Text Classifier and GPTZero, including a Moodle authenticity workflow. This is teacher-facing resource guidance, not a detector accuracy finding or student permission.
topicBasis.security_procurement: Central institutional IT security evaluations, commercial vendor data agreements, and unified procurement catalogs for artificial intelligence platforms remain an unverified evidence gap.

coursework.en: For IP Paris M1/M2 in 2026–27, outside examinations AI support is described for information search, knowledge deepening and reasoning checks, subject to full disclosure, plagiarism restrictions and explicit instructor bans. Member-school/course conditions remain separate.
coursework.zh: 针对 2026–2027 学年巴黎理工学院（IP Paris）M1 与 M2 硕士研究生，在考试之外，允许利用 AI 辅助检索信息、深化知识和检验推理与方法，但必须系统、准确、详细披露，受反剽窃规则约束，且教师有权在课程指示中予以明确禁止。各成员学校及具体课程要求须单独确认。
coursework.meaningZh: 仅适用于 IP Paris 2026–2027 学年 M1 与 M2 阶段硕士研究生。

exams.en: AI use in any examination requires explicit instructor authorization in the applicable instructions. This is limited to the covered 2026–27 Master scope.
exams.zh: 在所覆盖的 2026–2027 学年硕士范围内，任何形式的考试中一律禁止使用生成式 AI，除非授课教师在其考核指示中给予明确许可。未经授权的使用在法律上构成学术舞弊。
exams.meaningEn: IP Paris Master M1/M2, 2026–27; no general campus rule inferred.
exams.meaningZh: IP Paris 2026–2027 学年 M1/M2 硕士阶段；不推论为全校通用规则。

disclosure.en: The 2026–27 Master rules require systematic, precise and detailed disclosure for permitted non-exam AI support; examination citation follows academic citation rules. Citation alone does not authorize use.
disclosure.zh: 2026–2027 学年硕士规章要求，在平时课业中使用 AI 辅助必须进行系统、准确且详尽的披露；考试中若获准使用 AI 则必须严格遵守学术引用规则。仅进行引用绝不构成对未授权使用行为的合法化许可。
disclosure.meaningZh: IP Paris 2026–2027 学年 M1/M2 硕士阶段。

privacy_data.en: The Master regulation requires confidentiality for scientific, technical and institutional information. It does not establish AI vendor training, retention or student account controls.
privacy_data.zh: 硕士研究生规章要求学生在科研与论文撰写过程中对科学、技术及机构信息严格负有无期限保密义务。现有证据未确立 AI 服务商模型训练、数据留存或学生账号安全控制规则。
privacy_data.meaningEn: IP Paris Master M1/M2 research and thesis context; tool data controls remain unknown.
privacy_data.meaningZh: IP Paris 硕士 M1/M2 科研与学位论文环境；AI 工具数据管控规则尚不明确。

approved_tools.en: No student product access, procurement, cost or endorsement is established by this review. Teacher-facing resources are not student access or assessment permission.
approved_tools.zh: 在当前审核证据中，尚未确立面向全校学生的签约 AI 产品访问权限、采购安排、费用支持或官方推荐。面向教师的教学资源不代表学生具有工具权限或考核许可。
approved_tools.meaningZh: 无全校性一揽子工具授权。

research_publication.en: The regulation states confidentiality duties for Master research and thesis information; broader thesis, publication and third-party service conditions remain unverified.
research_publication.zh: 学习规章明确规定了硕士研究生在科研与论文信息方面的无期限保密义务；更广泛的学位论文出版、公开发表及第三方 AI 服务使用条件在现有证据中仍未核实。
research_publication.meaningEn: IP Paris Master M1/M2; other programs and agreements not established.
research_publication.meaningZh: IP Paris 硕士 M1/M2 阶段；其他项目与科研协议尚未确立。

academic_integrity.en: For 2026–27 IP Paris M1/M2, unauthorized exam AI use is fraud and reproduction beyond duly cited short excerpts is plagiarism. Academic penalties and disciplinary jurisdiction are stated separately; no numerical appeal deadline is established.
academic_integrity.zh: 对 2026–2027 学年 IP Paris 硕士 M1/M2 学生，未经授权在考试中使用 AI 构成学术舞弊，直接复制超出规范引注短摘录的 AI 生成内容构成抄袭剽窃。舞弊将导致成绩记 0 分、课程不予通过并移交学术委员会纪律分会处分；若涉嫌违纪发生于成员学校等其他公立高等教育机构，由该机构纪律委员会管辖并通报 IP Paris 主席。规章中未设立数字化的具体申诉期限。
academic_integrity.meaningEn: IP Paris Master M1/M2, academic year 2026–27 only.
academic_integrity.meaningZh: 仅限 IP Paris 2026–2027 学年硕士 M1/M2 阶段。

teaching_guidance.en: École polytechnique’s instructor resource catalogue lists Turnitin, AI Text Classifier and GPTZero, including a Moodle authenticity workflow. This is teacher-facing resource guidance, not a detector accuracy finding or student permission.
teaching_guidance.zh: 巴黎综合理工学院（École polytechnique）面向教师的教学资源目录列出了 Turnitin、AI Text Classifier 和 GPTZero 等工具，包括与 Moodle 关联的原创性检查工作流。此属面向教师的教学资源指南，不构成对检测器准确度的官方认定，亦不赋予学生考核使用许可。
teaching_guidance.meaningEn: École polytechnique Teaching & Learning Center, instructor-facing resources only; not all IP Paris students.
teaching_guidance.meaningZh: 仅限巴黎综合理工学院教学与学习中心的教师资源；不代表 IP Paris 全体学生。

security_procurement.en: Central institutional IT security evaluations, commercial vendor data agreements, and unified procurement catalogs for artificial intelligence platforms remain an unverified evidence gap.
security_procurement.zh: 针对人工智能平台的校级中央 IT 安全评估规程、商业供应商数据保护协议及统一采购目录在当前公开证据中仍属未核实的证据缺口。
security_procurement.meaningEn: IP Paris institution-wide IT procurement and vendor compliance.
security_procurement.meaningZh: IP Paris 全校范围 IT 采购与供应商合规。
